headline: HSIA 3rd terminal deal with Japanese consortium by 30 Nov: Millat
summary: Bangladesh plans to sign the third terminal deal at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport with a Japanese consortium by 30 November. Partial operations are planned from 16 December, with full operations taking up to 14 months.
why: Airport terminal concessions are large infrastructure projects that attract foreign investors and contractors. They also signal how Bangladesh manages public-private partnerships.
